commitments.title: Architecture Deep-Dive Session
commitments.status_notes: Completed successfully. Marcus validated VPC throughput.

commitments.title: SOC-2 Type II Audit Report Delivery
commitments.status_notes: No fulfilment recorded. Nadia explicitly made this a hard prerequisite for production access.

commitments.title: Pen-Test Executive Summary Delivery
commitments.status_notes: Queued with Security team pending mutual NDA execution.

interactions.title: Discovery Call
interactions.summary: Priya outlined ACME's scaling bottleneck. Their internal system cannot handle high-volume event spikes. They are 100% on AWS. Expressed urgent desire to launch before their Q4 holiday rush.
key_takeaways: Infrastructure is exclusively AWS us-east-1
Priya is our internal champion and will advocate internally
Target go-live ideally before end of October

interactions.title: Initial Security Scoping
interactions.summary: Nadia joined to assess compliance. Emphasized that ACME processes sensitive financial transactions. She stated unequivocally: 'No production data can touch your platform without our security team reviewing your audited SOC-2 Type II report.' AE verbally promised to email it within 48 hours.
key_takeaways: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: SOC-2 Type II report required before production data access
AE promised SOC-2 delivery (No fulfilment recorded)
Nadia is an absolute blocker if security documentation is absent

interactions.title: Technical Architecture Deep Dive
interactions.summary: Marcus grilled the team on latency and data pipeline ingestion. Veridian SA confirmed architecture. Marcus asked if deployment could be accelerated: Veridian SA confirmed standard deployment is 4 to 6 weeks due to VPC configuration and integration tests.
key_takeaways: Marcus satisfied with architecture specs
Deployment baseline established as 4 to 6 weeks
Marcus noted ACME has an annual production freeze starting October 15

interactions.title: Executive Business & CFO Alignment
interactions.summary: Linda joined to discuss financials. She established a hard budget cap: 'Our departmental allocation for this tool is strictly capped at $50,000 for FY2026. Anything higher will require Board review which we do not have time for.' Linda also stated she will not sign any multi-year contract without an opt-out.
key_takeaways: HARD BUDGET CAP: $50,000 annual limit
Linda will not approve multi-year lock-in without opt-out
Board review needed if price exceeds $50,000

interactions.title: Mid-Evaluation Check-in
interactions.summary: Priya confirmed team enthusiasm. Nadia reminded AE that she still has not received the SOC-2 report and asked for the third-party pen-test summary as well. AE promised to follow up with operations.
key_takeaways: Nadia reiterated missing SOC-2 report
Pen-test summary requested
Deal risk rising due to unfulfilled security promise

interactions.title: Competitive Threat Emergence
interactions.summary: Priya reached out privately: Competitor NimbusAI submitted an unsolicited proposal offering their platform for $48,000/year. Priya prefers Veridian's developer ergonomics, but warned that Linda is looking closely at NimbusAI's lower quote.
key_takeaways: COMPETITOR IDENTIFIED: NimbusAI pitching at $48,000/year
Linda is inclined towards NimbusAI due to the $48k price tag
Priya wants us to give her arguments to defend Veridian to Linda

interactions.title: Procurement Intake & Commercial Review
interactions.summary: Owen took over commercial negotiations. Demanded our master services agreement (MSA) and standard payment terms. Inquired about Net 60 payment terms. Stated that procurement evaluates vendors strictly on total cost and rapid onboarding.
key_takeaways: Procurement (Owen) entered the cycle
Owen pushing for Net 60 terms
Owen focused on vendor concessions and price reduction

interactions.title: Formal Proposal Delivery
interactions.summary: Veridian formally delivered the full enterprise proposal at list price: $72,000 ARR with 4-6 week onboarding. Linda frowned at the price. Owen remarked that 'there is significant room for commercial alignment before we can present this to the committee.'
key_takeaways: Formal quote delivered: $72,000 ARR
Expected pushback from Linda ($50k budget ceiling) and Owen
NimbusAI at $48k looming in the background

interactions.title: Pre-Closing Tactical Exchange
interactions.summary: Owen signaled they are ready to make a vendor decision by Friday. Warned that if Veridian cannot meet their aggressive delivery schedule before the October 15 freeze and get within budget, they will issue the PO to NimbusAI.
key_takeaways: Decision imminent: Friday deadline
October 15 production freeze is the real deadline driving panic
High probability of an aggressive concession demand incoming
